condition_or_formula: food_id, ingredient_id, observation_id and source_id must be globally unique.
Every nutrient observation must have source_id, source_record_id or explicit reason unavailable, and pinned release.
Restricted/unknown licences cannot enter distributable release.
Blank, trace, below detection limit, not analysed and true zero are separate states.
Canonical nutrient values use per 100 g edible portion; other bases require a linked weight.
Energy kcal/kJ distinguished; macro g; minerals mg or µg; no implicit conversion.
Default screening: 4×protein + 4×available carbohydrate + 9×fat + 2×fibre; source-specific factors override only when documented.
Absolute difference between reported and calculated energy ≤5%.
manual_requirement: Check special energy contributors if needed

condition_or_formula: Difference >5% and ≤10%.
manual_requirement: Inspect carbohydrate definition, alcohol, organic acids and fibre factors

condition_or_formula: Difference >10%.
manual_requirement: Resolve unit, column, food identity or derivation error

condition_or_formula: Water + protein + fat + available carbohydrate + fibre + ash should generally be 97–103 g/100 g.
95–105 g/100 g is the broader acceptance band.
manual_requirement: Investigate missing components or analytical methods

condition_or_formula: Protein, fat, carbohydrate, fibre and water each must be 0–100 g/100 g; negatives are invalid.
Raw and cooked, drained and undrained, salted and unsalted, peeled and unpeeled are distinct records.
A food match must import/review the nutrient profile and identity metadata, not only calories.
Every household measure used for scaling requires a measured or authoritative gram weight.
Mixed-dish calculation requires raw edible ingredient weights and final cooked edible yield.
Heat-sensitive nutrient calculations require an identified retention-factor set; macros still retain method metadata.
manual_requirement: Select factor set and cooking method

condition_or_formula: Automated checks do not replace second-person scientific review for promoted records.
manual_requirement: Named reviewer and review date required

condition_or_formula: A published record is not overwritten; corrections produce a new version and changelog entry.
